name: Hometown Cha-Cha-Cha
description: A big-city dentist opens up a practice in a close-knit seaside village, home to a charming jack-of-all-trades who is her polar opposite in every way.

videos.title: The Moment I Met You Everywhere
videos.overview: Things look bleak for Yoon Hye-jin after she quits her job. On a trip to Gongjin, she runs into a series of unfortunate events — and one unusual local.

videos.title: The Moment Your Sincerity Took a Step Forward
videos.overview: Hye-jin gets ready to welcome patients. But when a mishap at a party lands her in the town's bad graces, she needs guidance from Hong Du-sik.

videos.title: The Moment Your Heart Smiled at Me
videos.overview: A long drive to Seoul with Du-sik and other uninvited passengers tests Hye-jin's patience. Despite pain in her teeth, Kim Gam-ri refuses treatment.

videos.title: The Moment Your Temperature Melted My Heart
videos.overview: When a patient causes a disturbance at the office, Du-sik comes to the rescue. Elsewhere, Chang Yeong-guk learns that his first love is back in town.

videos.title: The Moment Your Feelings Floated on the Waves
videos.overview: Hye-jin is seen leaving Du-sik's home one morning. While she tries to recall what happened the night before, the town's gossip mill goes into overdrive.

videos.title: The Moment Your Gaze Goes Beyond Friendship
videos.overview: Hye-jin resolves to stop getting involved with Du-sik. Oh Ju-ri enters a singing competition in an attempt to win money to fix her snaggletooth.

videos.title: The Moment Your Loneliness Leaned on Me
videos.overview: Preparing to film his TV show in Gongjin, Ji Seong-hyeon has the perfect guide and house in mind — but getting them takes extra convincing.

videos.title: The Moment Your Existence Erases the Darkness
videos.overview: Du-sik catches a nasty cold. Hye-jin notices a troubling trend among her patients. A kidnapper on the loose puts the town on high alert.

videos.title: Your Seat, the Moment You Draw Your Daily Life
videos.overview: Du-sik puts on a show pretending to be Hye-jin's boyfriend in front of her visiting parents. Seong-hyeon makes a good impression on her father.

videos.title: The Moment Your Love Reaches 'Us'
videos.overview: Following an intruder attack in her home, a shaken Hye-jin leans on Du-sik. She's left more conflicted than ever after Seong-hyeon asks to talk.

videos.title: The Moment When Your Excitement Becomes My Happiness
videos.overview: Before Hye-jin makes things official with Du-sik, there's something she needs to do first. Attempts to keep their relationship a secret backfire on them.

videos.title: The Moment Your Wish Dreams of 'Together'
videos.overview: Hye-jin compiles a long bucket list of activities she wants to experience with Du-sik. Pyo Mi-seon and Choi Eun-cheol finally arrive on the same page.

videos.title: Your Today Is the Moment You Wish for Tomorrow
videos.overview: As Du-sik continues to keep his past shrouded in mystery, Hye-jin grows frustrated. Ham Yun-gyeong is struck by an emergency during a typhoon.

videos.title: The Moment Your Promise Bring Up Courage
videos.overview: Hye-jin and Du-sik take some time apart. Yu Cho-hui urges Yeong-guk to have courage about his feelings. Seong-hyeon and his team wrap up filming.

videos.title: The Moment Your Sadness Greets Spring
videos.overview: With his secrets out in the open, Du-sik must find a way to move on from the tragedies of his past. Hye-jin considers an enticing job offer.

videos.title: The Moment Our Lives Dance With Everyone
videos.overview: The town gathers to bid goodbye to a loved one. Hye-jin plans an unforgettable event for Du-sik, but it turns out he had the same idea.
